submittedPrompt: 绘制中文博客网页局部状态对照板，白底浅灰面、蓝色主动作、细线小圆角、字体清晰紧凑。每行是独立状态，细线留白分隔，只画指定组件，不画外部导航/页头、浏览器或审查注释。六个独立局部行，可向下加高。1 状态“正在读取装修配置，当前修改会保留…”。2 模板选择区标题“选择一种表达”，说明“从适合内容的版式开始，随时可以切换主题。”，三个可选版式卡“文字博客”，说明“留白与时间线，让文字自然流动”选中、“卡片杂志”，说明“用封面与精选，呈现丰富的主题”、“个人主页”，说明“从你出发，连接文章、项目与朋友”，三张小型版式缩略图。3 缺图片局部左右两栏：左方头像占位“你”，标题“头像”、按钮“选择图片”，提示“支持 JPEG、PNG、WebP，最大 10 MB。头像将裁切为正方形。”；右方横幅占位“给主页留一张风景”，标题“主页横幅”、按钮“选择图片”，提示“支持 JPEG、PNG、WebP，最大 10 MB。横幅将裁切为 3:1。”。4 红色“博客装修已变化，请重新读取”、可用“重新核对版本”按钮、保留“姓名”输入“示例作者”。5 另一独立已选图片局部：左为正方形合成头像，标题“头像”、两个独立按钮“选择图片”“移除”可用、状态“已选择图片”；右为3:1合成山景横幅，标题“主页横幅”、两个独立按钮“选择图片”“移除”可用、状态“已选择图片”，没有裁切控制。6 三个相互分离的小徽标样例，文字分别“与线上一致”“草稿尚未发布”“有未保存修改”，不要合成同一工作室状态。不画上传成功toast或新增动作。

sourceContracts.title: 博客装修：主题与个人资料
permissionRules: Owner session required for design/media APIs. Saving a draft, private preview or restoring history does not publish; version-checked explicit publish changes guest homepage.

fields.name: template
fields.constraints: journal文字博客; magazine卡片杂志; profile个人主页

fields.name: profile.avatar/cover
fields.constraints: only registered /blog/media/:hash references; referenced media must exist; total design images <=20MiB server-side

actions.label: 重新核对版本
actions.effect: Reload design and merge local changes

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: <=1250px editor/preview stack; <=760px forms/cards/dialog compress. Preview internally keeps 1100px desktop or 375px mobile viewport and scales to host (BlogPreviewViewport.vue:34). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete page with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Design save does not publish homepage. Dirty beforeunload guard is implemented.
Public profile bio is escaped plain text in profileIntro; public about page separately parses sanitized Markdown.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
